limits: Read from Terraform state only: no live inventory was read, so nothing is marked unmanaged. Attribute values and output values are never read: the only values kept from a resource are its id, ARN and tags (labels on Google Cloud), less the tags that look like secrets. 2 states read by terraform_remote_state are not in this snapshot, so anything that depends on them stops at an external placeholder: s3://acme-other/shared.tfstate, s3://acme-tfstate/env:/staging/net.tfstate. 1 terraform_remote_state data sources use a backend whose settings name no state this reader can place, so they point to a placeholder. 1 dependencies name an address the state does not hold and are left out. can_assume edges come only from the trust policies of the aws_iam_role resources a state holds: a role made outside Terraform has none, and identity policies, permission boundaries, service control policies and session policies are not read, so an edge says a trust policy allows it, not that the principal can. An account, a wildcard, a condition, a Deny statement or another account makes an edge inferred, and no condition or Deny is evaluated. can_read and can_write edges come only from iam-lens results read from a file: infra-ontology does not run iam-lens, read policies or call the cloud, so an edge says iam-lens judged the principal allowed on the IAM data it was given, which this snapshot does not hold and which may be older than the rest of it. can_read and can_write mean only that iam-lens classes an action the principal is allowed as Read or List (can_read), or as Write, Tagging or Permissions management (can_write): they do not say the principal can read or write the data in the resource, since those levels include metadata reads such as s3:GetBucketLocation and actions such as lambda:InvokeFunction, kms:Decrypt, sns:Publish, sqs:SendMessage and iam:PassRole. Another level of action and any sts action make no edge. A result that says its analysis was incomplete or scoped makes inferred edges with the basis iam_lens_partial, since a deny or a service control policy may be missing from it. A result with a condition makes an inferred edge, and the condition is not kept; public access (anonymous or *), a principal of another account or of an account not known, and an account principal make inferred edges too. Only the resources the snapshot holds have edges. 1 iam-lens results are for a resource this snapshot does not hold, and have no edge. 1 iam-lens results are for a resource that is not a concrete ARN (a wildcard, or too long), and have no edge. 1 iam-lens results say they did not check every account (allAccountsChecked is false: a run limited by a principal scope or to some accounts), so who can reach the resource is not all they list. 1 iam-lens results say they found no collected data for an account, organization or principal the resource's policy names, so who can reach the resource is not all they list. 2 iam-lens entries are for an action of a level that makes no edge, or an sts action. 1 principals of iam-lens results (sessions, ARNs of other services, strings that are not a principal) are not turned into edges.
